description:
Perform a static setup for Finite Element Analysis (FEM) on a mechanical part.

1. Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_housing_bracket.FCStd'.
2. Switch to the FEM Workbench.
3. Create a new Analysis container.
4. Create a Material for the solid: Select 'Steel-Generic' (or similar Steel) from the standard material library and ensure it is assigned to the bracket body.
5. Create a Fixed Constraint and apply it to the flat bottom face of the bracket (the face lying on the XY plane).
6. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_bracket_fem.FCStd'.
